## Implementation

- **OQ-468 — the five-op promotion.** `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/ops.rs`:
  `amend`/`list_leases`/`archive`/`grant`/`revoke_lease` promoted
  `experimental` → `stable` in the CF-488-adopted grouping (`amend` W,
  `list_leases` R, the Group-S trio `staged_stable` — honestly
  `Refused{stage_pending}` until its slice implements); the
  `ExperimentalRequired` gate no longer covers them and the frozen error
  sums publish the named refusals. Artifacts regenerated by
  `hh-codegen` (`schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json`, `compat-1.matrix.json`,
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs`,
  `clients/ts/hh-embed.ts`) — check-drift green. Records: the five
  `AssumptionDebtRecord`s retire `promoted_to_stable` on ADR-0216's
  R4.15c amendment log; ADR-0176/0177 carry the promotion's
  amendment-log entries; the §7.1 marker flipped to `[[ANSWERED
  OQ-468]]` and the §7.4 op rows re-tiered in
  `spec/sections/07-surfaces.md` + `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md`.
- **OQ-430 — ADR-0192 G-4's touched-handles default.**
  `crates/hh-subagent`: `MergeConflictRecord.touched_handles` carries
  each conflict's evidence handles; `MergeReport` gains
  `touched_handles[]` (sorted union) + `selected_validators[]`; the
  default pass selects only bound validators whose criterion evidence
  intersects the touched set — `validator_selected{full_contract}` is
  the explicit opt-in (`MergePolicy::ValidatorSelected{full_contract}`,
  additive serde with the legacy `"validator_selected"` spelling
  decoding to the default arm); `MergeReport::blocks_completion` is
  G-4's gate predicate — a touched criterion is blocked unless a
  satisfied verdict came from a *selected* validator. The durable
  `control.merge.completed` row carries the same selection.
- **CF-492 — `seal` in the closed stage set.** `Stage::Seal` minted in
  `crates/hh-assembly/src/diagnostics.rs` (`stage ∈ {…, resume, seal}`);
  the stage-5 seal self-check's diagnostic reports `Stage::Seal` — the
  `hh-lab::assembly::service` stage-6b `SealError` mapping conformed.
  Spec conform per the protocol (§3.3.5 stage set + the §06
  `AssemblyDiagnostic` row; manifest lines; front-matter).
- **CF-493 — `verified_by[]`.** `crates/hh-xcheck/src/lib.rs`:
  `CandidateEvidence{candidate, evidence_class, evidence_ref}` + the
  `E1_CHECK` (`fixture-verified`), `E2_RUN`/`E3_RUN`
  (`foreign-run-verified`) records; `ArmSpec.verified_by` and
  `PENDING_CELLS` quadruples carry them — the six original arms/cells
  name E1+E2+E3, the R4.3 arms name E1+E3 only (the committed
  `foreign/e2-python` tree cannot answer them — no E2 claim minted);
  `polyglot-ci.two-toolchain` and the `*.e2-replay` cells carry empty
  `verified_by[]`. `crates/hh-xcheck/src/export.rs` emits the member on
  `arms[]` + `pending_cells[]`; `status` stays `e1-self-checked` /
  `environment-pending` — verified_by is partial discharge, never
  closure. Bundle + CHECKER.md regenerated by `hh-xcheck export`
  (byte-deterministic leg re-passed); CHECKER.md's honesty boundary
  documents the member; E2/E3 READMEs carry dated CF-493 notes;
  `scripts/xcheck-foreign.sh` green (E1 97/97, E2 49/49, E3 57/57).
- **OQ-173 — `legal_hold`.** `RetentionPolicy.legal_hold` (additive
  member; an absent member decodes `false`, never coerced);
  `set_legal_hold` gates set/clear at `authority ≥ principal` else
  `Refused{legal_hold = authority_below_principal}`; while held, the
  shared `gc`/`gc_bounded` admission — every gc path incl. the lab-wide
  whole-run delete — refuses `Refused{gc = legal_hold}` *before* any
  durable row or byte mutation (asserted: no `lifecycle.ledger.gc` row
  and the blob intact). Caller fallout: `gc_policy(…)` helpers in
  hh-ledger/hh-results test files.
